intro: Luxus Hills Phase 10 is a landed housing project in District 28, with a listed address at Seletar Green Walk / Luxus Hill Heights. Our project file names Bukit Sembawang Estates (Singapore United Estates) as the developer and points to the developer’s AGM slides dated 31 July 2026. This entry is not officially confirmed: a September 2026 launch recorded from third-party caveat data is not treated as official, and typologies, unit counts, tenure and an expected third-quarter 2028 TOP discussed on those slides are left out of the facts below. The file notes that this project was included for a 2026 launch, not for 2026–27 keys. If you have sale documents, use those for typologies and for any later completion date. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Luxus Hills Phase 10 renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Luxus Hills Phase 10 interior
sections.text:
This is a landed house, not a shop. When an approved plan is in hand, Maison would start with built-in carpentry — a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and storage in circulation or a family room — specified as custom work, not as IKEA-style furniture, and photographed in wide or closer, material-led views. We will not invent a mix of terraces and detached houses, and no official floor plan is on file for this pack.

Belgravia Ace, also in District 28 in this batch, and Pollen Collection, already live in the same district, are nearby landed links. 8@BT, packed earlier, is a Bukit Sembawang condominium page and is not a typologies reference for this phase. We will not invent walking times to Seletar or to any MRT station, and we will not treat an expected 2028 TOP as a confirmed key date.

If you are buying or waiting on this phase, use the lead time to freeze a design from the official plan, then follow defects, management approval and fabrication after keys. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan when you have it. We are not affiliated with Bukit Sembawang Estates.

faq.a: After handover, inspect defects and obtain the management corporation’s renovation approval before carpentry is fabricated.
